method: Warm incremental CLI build, then fresh full carrier and devkit builds sequentially. No agent compilation, tests or candidate campaigns overlapped the timed board runs. One sample per board; OS/tool caches and unrelated host background activity uncontrolled. Front/back renders inspected after both runs ended.

compile.scope: Warm incremental build with ccache enabled, including relink after a header-comment change; NOT a clean compile or cold-cache benchmark

cpl_entries.note: CPL population is a subset of all PCB instances; do not conflate these counts

carrier.visual_observation: Top SoM reserve remains clear; perimeter connectors and controls retained. Bottom USB/JTAG and decoupling groups remain localized, with substantial unused bottom area. Empty visual area is not evidence of permitted relocation or assembly clearance.

mandatory_skips.manual: project has no bringup_rails, bringup_en, bringup_en_modules, bringup_modules
mandatory_skips.scfw: project has no bringup_en, bringup_modules, bringup_rails, usb_pd, board_services, bringup_en_modules

limitations: Revision-to-revision totals only, not language-only speedups. Python was not rerun in this batch.

Historical phase spans overlap; no unsupported exclusive Python generation/render/audit comparison is inferred.
